description: OFAC indefinitely suspended General License G on 24 August 2026. Since 2014 that licence had been the legal basis for US universities and testing companies to provide educational services to Iranians. Wind-down transactions were allowed until 8 September 2026.
energy_note: The ladder out of the country withdrawn in a single administrative act.

description: ETS told Radio Farda it had 'paused administration of the TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran effective immediately'. Appointment calendars bookable as far out as January shrank within a day to two centres near Tehran, then vanished.

IELTS testing inside Iran ended on 31 January 2026 after IDP cited financial and regulatory factors outside its control. IELTS is British/Australian, not American, so the OFAC suspension does not explain it - the withdrawal was independent.
notes: Two separate mechanisms arriving at the same result within seven months.

aspect: Duolingo cut off by identity document
description: The Duolingo English Test announced it would cease serving individuals residing in Iran OR HOLDING IRANIAN IDENTIFICATION DOCUMENTS from 1 September 2026 - so the restriction follows the passport, not the address.
energy_note: Excluded by nationality even if you left years ago.

description: ETS says Iranians may travel abroad to sit the exams. That means flights and at least one night's accommodation in Turkey or Armenia on top of the fee - for a test that is itself a precondition of a scholarship application.

The United States fully suspended visa issuance to Iranian nationals across nearly all categories from 1 January 2026. Students are therefore paying to travel abroad to sit a test for a country that will not issue them a visa.
Iranian TOEFL and GRE candidates launched an online petition urging ETS to restore access, saying thousands were losing access to tests required for admissions and scholarships.

aspect: SCENARIO - the test that moved to another country
description: Maryam needs IELTS 7.0 for her licensing pathway. Testing in Iran ended in January. The nearest centre is Yerevan: flight USD 280, two nights USD 90, test fee USD 250, and a day either side. She needs 7.0 in writing and gets 6.5. She books again.
